allowed_work: probability calibration policy (identity vs temperature, selected once on training OOF)

5_full_data_refit_and_deployment_audit.teacher_target: crossfit_teacher_targets_6387.csv (each sample supervised only by the teacher for its own outer fold)
5_full_data_refit_and_deployment_audit.encoder_consistency: canonical product cache generated one sequence per ProtT5 forward (runs/mpce_3dkd_product_single_cache.pt) so arbitrary API queries reproduce training-time features exactly
